$comment: Philippine non-working days used for deadline shifting. 2026: per Proclamation No. 1006 s.2025 (verified Aug 4, 2026, incl. the separately proclaimed Eid dates, Proc 1189 and 1264 s.2026). 2027: per Proclamation No. 1427 s.2026 (signed Sept 8, 2026, as reported by the PCO, GMA News and Philstar): the dates fixed by law plus four special non-working days (Feb 6, Mar 27, Nov 2, Dec 24). Eid'l Fitr / Eid'l Adha 2027 are proclaimed separately and are added when proclaimed. Special WORKING days (e.g. EDSA anniversary, Feb 25) are excluded; offices are open.

shiftRule.value: A filing/payment deadline falling on a Saturday, Sunday, or non-working holiday moves to the next working day
legalBasis: The rule printed in the BIR's annual Tax Calendar and form instructions ('If the due date falls on a Saturday, Sunday or holiday, the deadline shall be moved to the next working day')
RR 26-2002 (same treatment in the eFPS staggered-filing framework)
shiftRule.notes: Applied to BIR deadlines and, as the safe default, to SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG/LGU/SEC dates. Deadlines only ever move later, never earlier; weekday special non-working days (Dec 8, Dec 24, Dec 31) shift deadlines just like regular holidays; purely LOCAL holidays do not move national e-filing deadlines. The 13th-month-pay deadline is an exception — it must be met on or before Dec 24.

confidenceNote: 2026 dates are verified against Proclamation No. 1006 s.2025 and the Eid proclamations. 2027 dates are verified against Proclamation No. 1427 s.2026 as reported by the PCO, GMA News and Philstar (the Official Gazette text could not be opened here). The 2027 Eid'l Fitr and Eid'l Adha dates are not yet proclaimed and are not in the list, so a deadline next to them may still move one more day.

legalBasis: EO 292 (Administrative Code of 1987) Book I Sec 26, as amended by RA 9492
RA 10966 (Feast of the Immaculate Conception, Dec 8)
fixedByLaw.notes: The holidays fixed by law, computed for any year that has no proclaimed list below (a proclaimed list replaces them for its year). Maundy Thursday and Good Friday are the Thursday and Friday before Easter Sunday; National Heroes Day is the last Monday of August. Not included because a proclamation sets them: Eid'l Fitr and Eid'l Adha, Chinese New Year, Black Saturday, Nov 2, Dec 24, election days and other special days. A proclamation may also move a holiday under RA 9492, so until a year's list is proclaimed a deadline may move one or more days later than shown.

notes2027.notes: Proclamation No. 1427 s.2026 (Sept 8, 2026) set the 2027 holidays: the regular holidays and special days fixed by law, plus special non-working days on Feb 6 (Chinese New Year, a Saturday), Mar 27 (Black Saturday), Nov 2 (All Souls' Day, a Tuesday) and Dec 24 (Christmas Eve, a Friday). Feb 25 (EDSA anniversary) stays a special WORKING day. Still pending: Eid'l Fitr and Eid'l Adha 2027 (astronomical estimates: Eid'l Fitr about Mar 9, Eid'l Adha about May 16), proclaimed separately closer to the dates; add them here when proclaimed. Nov 2, 2027 moves the Q3 2027 1601-EQ, 1601-FQ and QAP and the September 2027 SSS and PhilHealth payments from Tue Nov 2 to Wed Nov 3.
